answer: Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The ferrous decay curve is applied at each close, oasis records the drop, and garden recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. The attacker spends 297 dollars and 11 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
